results.term_definition: Global warming is a warming of a planet's atmosphere by greenhouse gases, such as water molecules, carbon dioxide, methane, etc. This is caused by an increase in the greenhouse effect where more infrared radiation is trapped by the atmosphere, thus increasing the global mean temperature of a planet. The sources of greenhouse gases can be natural or (on Earth) additionally caused by human industrial activity. Global warming on Earth will have significant very long-term effects on the planet, including short- and medium-term changes in local weather patterns, habitat destruction, and sea level rise.
